scope: Independent review of the fixed stock IOM operation-2 preparation prefix through 0x55ca72 and bounded disable-then-prepare ordering.

findings.finding: Success is checked only through 0x55ca72, before physical power-domain callbacks. The original fragment retains a frame at the cut; the C helper returns preparation status. Do not claim full power operation or power-down success from zero status.
The aliased descriptor rows are authenticated values, while the compatibility table pointer is supplied by the harness. Dynamic callback table reads/calls beyond the cut remain unresolved.
The sequence cases use nonwrapping hardware indices; no closure of the prior stock-versus-O2 curIdx intermediate-write difference or internal-RAM/DMA observer identity is claimed.
No allocator/free, callback drain, NVIC cleanup, DMA quiescence, physical power transition, or full shutdown-safety proof.

limits: Fixed power operation2 prefix only, success stops55ca72 before physical power callbacks; real early return2/3 paths execute. Source0 means prepared, not powered down. Sequence follows disable then prepare with no physical step/uninitialize. No stubs. Authenticated IOM descriptor field values/aliasing, synthetic descriptor pointer and raw MMIO/serialized states; no timeout/callback/NVIC/DMA/free/quiescence proof. No closure of prior wrapped-index asynchronous ownership limitation; sequence cases use nonwrap hardware index.
